adjudication.rationale: In `handleCancelBooking.ts`, `bookingCalendarReference` changed from a single `find(...)` to `filter(...)` and the cancellation logic now loops `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)` (around the block starting near the new `if (bookingCalendarReference.length > 0) {`). Inside that loop, the recurring-event branch (`if (bookingToDelete.eventType?.recurringEvent && bookingToDelete.recurringEventId && allRemainingBookings)`) still fans out deletes across *all* calendar credentials and *all* `updatedBookings`, using `updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes("_calendar"))` for the UID. Because this whole fan-out now executes once per calendar reference, multiple calendar references will cause the same credential×booking deletions to be repeated, producing redundant third-party `deleteEvent` calls against the same external UIDs.
